WITH pubs AS (
  SELECT 
    "publication_date" AS publication_date,
    "publication_number" AS publication_number,
    "country_code" AS country_code,
    -- extract inventor array length; alias to unquoted name
    CASE 
      WHEN "inventor" IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TYPEOF("inventor") = 'ARRAY' THEN ARRAY_SIZE("inventor")
      WHEN TYPEOF("inventor") = 'OBJECT' THEN 1
      ELSE NULL
    END AS inventor_count
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    publication_date,
    publication_number,
    country_code,
    inventor_count,
    -- compute 5-year bucket start year between 1960 and 2020 inclusive
    FLOOR((publication_date - 1960) / 5) * 5 + 1960 AS period_start
  FROM pubs
  WHERE publication_date IS NOT NULL
    AND publication_date BETWEEN 1960 AND 2024 -- allow grouping up to 2024 but will filter next
    AND inventor_count IS NOT NULL
    AND inventor_count > 0
),
periods AS (
  -- generate desired 5-year periods 1960-1964 ... 2020-2024, then will filter to 1960-2020 per user (period start <=2020)
  SELECT seq4() * 5 + 1960 AS period_start
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 13)) -- (1960 + 5*0 .. 5*12 = 2020) yields 13 periods through 2020
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.period_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.country_code = 'CA' THEN f.publication_number END) AS ca_publication_count,
    AVG(f.inventor_count) AS avg_inventors_per_publication,
    COUNT(*) AS total_pub_count_in_period
  FROM periods p
  LEFT JOIN filtered f
    ON f.period_start = p.period_start
  GROUP BY p.period_start
)
SELECT
  period_start,
  period_start || '-' || (period_start + 4) AS period_label,
  COALESCE(ROUND(avg_inventors_per_publication, 4), 0) AS avg_inventors_per_publication,
  COALESCE(ca_publication_count, 0) AS ca_publication_count
FROM agg
ORDER BY period_start

    p.filing_date,
    a.value:"name"::STRING AS assignee_name

  LATERAL FLATTEN(input => (SELECT "assignee_harmonized" FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS WHERE "publication_number" = p.publication_number)) a

granted_2010 AS (
  SELECT
    publication_number,
    application_number,
    family_id,
    filing_date,
    grant_date,
    CASE
      WHEN grant_date IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE FLOOR(grant_date / 10000)
    END AS grant_year
  FROM pubs

),
utility_2010 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM granted_2010
  WHERE grant_year = 2010
),
-- build citing relationships by matching citations in the publication "citation" VARIANT field.
-- We look across all publications: a citing pub that has a citation entry referencing the cited application's application_number.
all_pubs AS (
  SELECT
    "publication_number" AS publication_number,
    "application_number" AS application_number,
    "family_id" AS family_id,
    "filing_date" AS filing_date,
    "publication_date" AS publication_date,
    "citation" AS citation
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
),

  SELECT
    ap.publication_number AS citing_publication_number,
    ap.application_number AS citing_application_number,
    c.value AS citation_obj
  FROM all_pubs ap,
  LATERAL FLATTEN(input => ap.citation) c
),

  SELECT
    citing_publication_number,
    citing_application_number,
    -- attempt to get application_number from the citation object; if not present, try publication_number
    COALESCE(
      citation_obj:"application_number"::STRING,
      citation_obj:"applicationNumber"::STRING,
      citation_obj:"publication_number"::STRING,
      citation_obj:"publicationNumber"::STRING,
      citation_obj:"patent"::STRING
    ) AS cited_application_number,
    -- also extract cited publication_number if available
    COALESCE(
      citation_obj:"publication_number"::STRING,
      citation_obj:"publicationNumber"::STRING,
      citation_obj:"publication"::STRING
    ) AS cited_publication_number
  FROM flattened_citations
  WHERE citation_obj IS NOT NULL
),
-- join extracted citations to the patents of interest by application_number or publication_number or family membership.
-- First, map cited identifiers to application_number of target patents (utility_2010)
target_ids AS (
  SELECT
    application_number AS target_application_number,
    publication_number AS target_publication_number,
    family_id AS target_family_id,
    filing_date AS target_filing_date
  FROM utility_2010
),
-- match citations where extracted cited_application_number equals target_application_number

  SELECT
    e.citing_application_number,
    t.target_application_number,
    t.target_filing_date

  JOIN target_ids t

    )
  UNION
  -- also match by cited_publication_number

    t.target_application_number,
    t.target_filing_date

within_10yr AS (
  SELECT
    target_application_number,
    citing_application_number,
    target_filing_date,
    citing_publication_date,
    -- compute date conversions defensively
    CASE
      WHEN target_filing_date IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LENGTH(TO_VARCHAR(target_filing_date)) = 8 THEN TO_DATE(TO_VARCHAR(target_filing_date),'YYYYMMDD')

    DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("created_at"), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS created_month
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDERS
  WHERE "created_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ("created_at") < TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(DATE_PART(EPOCH_SECOND, '2023-01-01'::timestamp)) = FALSE
),
-- Compute first purchase month per user up to end of 2022
first_purchase AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MIN(created_date) AS first_purchase_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(created_date)) AS first_purchase_month
  FROM orders
  WHERE created_date < '2023-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
),
-- Keep orders up to end of 2022 and associate with user's first month
user_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.user_id,
    fp.first_purchase_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.created_date) AS order_month,
    DATEDIFF(month, fp.first_purchase_month, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.created_date)) AS months_since_first
  FROM orders o
  JOIN first_purchase fp ON o.user_id = fp.user_id
  WHERE o.created_date < '2023-01-01'
),
-- For each user determine whether they made a purchase in months 0,1,2,3 (first..fourth month)
user_month_flags AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_first = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_1_flag,
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_2_flag,
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_first = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_3_flag,
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_first = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_4_flag,
    first_purchase_month
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE months_since_first BETWEEN 0 AND 3
  GROUP BY user_id, first_purchase_month
),
-- Count users per cohort month and calculate percentages
cohort_counts AS (
  SELECT
    first_purchase_month,
    COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
    SUM(month_1_flag) AS users_in_month_1,
    SUM(month_2_flag) AS users_in_month_2,
    SUM(month_3_flag) AS users_in_month_3,
    SUM(month_4_flag) AS users_in_month_4
  FROM user_month_flags
  GROUP BY first_purchase_month
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(first_purchase_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS cohort_month,
  cohort_size,
  ROUND(100.0 * users_in_month_1 / NULLIF(cohort_size,0), 2) AS pct_month_1,
  ROUND(100.0 * users_in_month_2 / NULLIF(cohort_size,0), 2) AS pct_month_2,
  ROUND(100.0 * users_in_month_3 / NULLIF(cohort_size,0), 2) AS pct_month_3,
  ROUND(100.0 * users_in_month_4 / NULLIF(cohort_size,0), 2) AS pct_month_4
FROM cohort_counts
ORDER BY first_purchase_month

WITH orders_cte AS (
  SELECT
    "order_id" AS order_id,
    "created_at" AS created_at,
    "status" AS status
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDERS
  WHERE "status" = 'completed'
),
order_items_cte AS (
  SELECT
    "order_id" AS order_id,
    "product_id" AS product_id,
    "sale_price" AS sale_price
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS
),
products_cte AS (
  SELECT
    "id" AS product_id,
    "category" AS category
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS
),
-- join orders -> order_items -> products to get category per order and sale_price
orders_with_category AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id AS order_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(o.created_at))::DATE AS month,
    p.category AS category,
    oi.sale_price AS sale_price
  FROM orders_cte o
  JOIN order_items_cte oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products_cte p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
),
-- For each category and month compute unique orders count and total revenue
monthly_category_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS unique_orders,
    SUM(sale_price) AS revenue
  FROM orders_with_category
  GROUP BY category, month
),
-- compute month-over-month percentage growth per category
mom_growth AS (
  SELECT
    m.category AS category,
    m.month AS month,
    m.unique_orders AS unique_orders,
    LAG(m.unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month) AS prev_unique_orders,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(m.unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month) IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LAG(m.unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (m.unique_orders - LAG(m.unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month))
           / LAG(m.unique_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month)
    END AS orders_pct_change,
    m.revenue AS revenue,
    LAG(m.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month) AS prev_revenue,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(m.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month) IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LAG(m.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (m.revenue - LAG(m.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month))
           / LAG(m.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY m.category ORDER BY m.month)
    END AS revenue_pct_change
  FROM monthly_category_metrics m
),
-- average the monthly orders_pct_change per category (exclude NULLs)
avg_orders_growth AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    AVG(orders_pct_change) AS avg_monthly_orders_growth
  FROM mom_growth
  WHERE orders_pct_change IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY category
),
-- pick category with highest average orders growth
top_category AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    avg_monthly_orders_growth
  FROM avg_orders_growth
  ORDER BY avg_monthly_orders_growth DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- for that category compute average monthly revenue growth (average of revenue_pct_change excluding NULLs)
avg_revenue_growth_for_top AS (
  SELECT
    t.category AS category,
    t.avg_monthly_orders_growth AS avg_monthly_orders_growth,
    AVG(m.revenue_pct_change) AS avg_monthly_revenue_growth
  FROM top_category t
  JOIN mom_growth m ON m.category = t.category
  WHERE m.revenue_pct_change IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.category, t.avg_monthly_orders_growth
)
SELECT
  category,
  avg_monthly_orders_growth,
  avg_monthly_revenue_growth
FROM avg_revenue_growth_for_top

    CASE WHEN qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_cost_assuming_one_per_row) END AS total_cost,

WITH
orders_cte AS (
  SELECT
    "order_id" AS order_id,
    "created_at" AS created_at
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDERS
),
order_items_cte AS (
  SELECT
    "order_id" AS order_id,
    "product_id" AS product_id,
    "sale_price" AS sale_price,
    "created_at" AS oi_created_at
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS
),
products_cte AS (
  SELECT
    "id" AS product_id,
    "category" AS category,
    "cost" AS cost,
    "retail_price" AS retail_price
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS
),
-- join orders -> order_items -> products, compute month (YYYY-MM) from order created_at (assume epoch milliseconds)
joined AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(o.created_at/1000)), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    p.category AS category,
    oi.order_id AS order_id,
    oi.sale_price AS sale_price,
    COALESCE(p.cost,0) AS cost
  FROM order_items_cte oi
  JOIN orders_cte o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products_cte p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(o.created_at/1000)) BETWEEN DATE_FROM_PARTS(2019,6,1) AND DATE_FROM_PARTS(2019,12,31)
),
-- aggregate per month and category
agg AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COALESCE(category,'(unknown)') AS category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(COALESCE(sale_price,0)) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(COALESCE(sale_price,0) - COALESCE(cost,0)) AS total_profit
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY month, category
),
-- ensure months with no data/categories propagated? We'll rely on present data; include June for baseline but exclude from final output
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    LAG(total_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_orders,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue,
    LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_profit,
    -- baseline = value in June 2019 for this category
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2019-06' THEN total_orders END) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS baseline_orders,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2019-06' THEN total_revenue END) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS baseline_revenue,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2019-06' THEN total_profit END) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS baseline_profit
  FROM agg a
),
-- compute growth rates: month-over-month growth compared to June 2019 baseline for months >= July 2019
final_calc AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    category,
    total_orders,
    total_revenue,
    total_profit,
    -- month-over-month growth rates relative to June 2019 baseline (for months >= July 2019). For June rows baseline = same month.
    CASE
      WHEN month = '2019-06' THEN NULL
      WHEN baseline_orders IS NULL OR baseline_orders = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (total_orders - baseline_orders) / baseline_orders
    END AS growth_vs_june_orders,
    CASE
      WHEN month = '2019-06' THEN NULL
      WHEN baseline_revenue IS NULL OR baseline_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (total_revenue - baseline_revenue) / baseline_revenue
    END AS growth_vs_june_revenue,
    CASE
      WHEN month = '2019-06' THEN NULL
      WHEN baseline_profit IS NULL OR baseline_profit = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (total_profit - baseline_profit) / baseline_profit
    END AS growth_vs_june_profit
  FROM with_prev
)
SELECT
  month,
  category,
  total_orders,
  total_revenue,
  total_profit,
  growth_vs_june_orders,
  growth_vs_june_revenue,
  growth_vs_june_profit
FROM final_calc
WHERE month <> '2019-06'
  AND month BETWEEN '2019-06' AND '2019-12'
ORDER BY month ASC, category ASC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    "SOPInstanceUID" AS sop_instance_uid,
    "Modality" AS modality,
    "PatientID" AS patient_id,
    "SpecimenPreparationSequence" AS specimen_prep,
    "NumberOfFrames" AS number_of_frames,
    "ImageType" AS image_type,
    "Collection" AS collection
  FROM IDC.IDC_V17.DICOM_METADATA
),
-- Expand SpecimenPreparationSequence (VARIANT) to check for eosin mention
prep AS (
  SELECT
    sop_instance_uid,
    modality,
    patient_id,
    number_of_frames,
    image_type,
    collection,
    f.value::string AS prep_item
  FROM base,
  LATERAL FLATTEN(input => specimen_prep) f
  WHERE specimen_prep IS NOT NULL
),
-- Filter for TCGA-BRCA collection, modality SM, ImageType containing 'WS' or 'WHOLE' (heuristic for whole slide), and prep mentioning eosin (case-insensitive)
filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sop_instance_uid,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER(number_of_frames) AS frames
  FROM prep
  WHERE
    COALESCE(collection, '') ILIKE '%TCGA-BRCA%' 
    AND COALESCE(modality, '') = 'SM'
    AND (
      COALESCE(image_type::string, '') ILIKE '%WS%' 
      OR COALESCE(image_type::string, '') ILIKE '%WHOLE%' 
      OR COALESCE(image_type::string, '') ILIKE '%WHOLESLIDE%'
    )
    AND LOWER(prep_item) LIKE '%eosin%'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(frames),0) AS total_frames_eosin_sm_tcga_brca
FROM filtered
